description: Freiburger and Dulcich bring a '60 Ford Ranchero back to life after rescuing it from over 40 years of neglect; with a fresh 283 power transplant ahead of the Muncie four-speed, the guys overhaul the entire drivetrain.

description: Alex and Lucky team up with the deep pockets at PEAK performance, diving into their wallet and their '63 Bel Air wagon to see how easily their prepared parts come together.

title: Hot Rod Garage
description: Tony Angelo and Lucky Costa take their trusty shop truck, the Crown Hick, a 1966 Ford F-100 sitting on a 2007 Crown Victoria complete chassis, and add boost for more power.

description: For the season finale, Paul Teutul Sr. builds a Valentine's Day bike for the love of his life, Joannie Kay. Will the keyring of a custom ride be enough to melt her heart? Paul Sr. goes on the hunt for just the right adornment to make this gift resonate.

title: Two Guys Garage

description: The new owner of a 1965 Chevy Impala scraps plans to restore the vehicle to its former glory due to a shortage of time and money.
